outcome: Mode of delivery (unplanned and emergency cesarean delivery, spontaneous vaginal delivery)
Composite secondary maternal and neonatal outcomes
cohort: The study included 16,808 records of individuals who underwent labour induction in Newfoundland and Labrador between 2002 and 2023.
finding: Elevated pre-pregnancy BMI increases the risks of unplanned and emergency cesarean delivery among those who undergo induction of labour.
mod_finding: Elevated pre-pregnancy BMI significantly increases the risks of unplanned and emergency cesarean delivery and decreases the likelihood of spontaneous vaginal delivery among those undergoing labour induction.
